comment: MIRRORS the S3 owner walk's OpenAI deferral (2026-08-30 — the exact reason services/core/app/chat.py's always-on deferral guard exists, per tests/test_chat_deferral.py's module docstring): the model committed to a search ('I'll perform a web search...') and called no tool, so the turn ended reading like it was still working — a broken promise. tool_called('web_search') proves the promise was actually kept; guard_absent('deferral') proves the always-on detector found no unbacked commitment to redirect (a real deferral leaves exactly one guard span). MECHANICAL, not a proxy — both facts are read directly off the trace, not interpreted from prose.
